[[Helping the People of Ascalon]]
[[The Ambassador's Quandary]] | map = [[File:The King's Message map.jpg‎|250px]] | map1text = The way to [[Ambassador Zain]] from [[Ascalon City]]. | experience reward = 100 | completion reward = 50g }} [[Warmaster Tydus]] asks you to deliver a message to [[Ambassador Zain]] of [[Kryta]]. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = prophecies }} ===Objectives=== * Gather a [[party]] in [[Ascalon City]]. Sir Tydus recommends bringing [[Alesia]] to heal you. * Go to [[Old Ascalon]]. Deliver the [[Royal Message|royal message]] to Ambassador Zain. ===Reward=== * 100 [[Experience]] * 50 [[Gold]] * [[War Hammer]] ''(has the [[skin]] of a [[Foehammer]])'' ** [[Blunt damage|Blunt Dmg]]: 13-20 (Requires 3 [[Hammer Mastery]]) ** [[Armor rating|Armor]] +5 (while [[attacking]]) ** [[Damage]] +10% (vs. [[Hex]]ed [[foe]]s) ==Walkthrough== Invite at least one player or [[henchman]] to your party before stepping through the portal into [[Old Ascalon]]. Head straight east toward a small Krytan camp ahead. Beware of the two [[Devourer]]s that pop up from the ground next to the bridge if you get too close to them. If you're a warrior, you can easily pick up quests from [[Warmaster Grast]] who is on the route of this quest (just past the bridge). ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{w}} 10 (20) [[Prince Rurik]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Warmaster Tydus :''"I have an important task for you. Please deliver this '''royal message''' to '''Ambassador Zain''' of Kryta. His camp can be found just outside the city. Go out the western gate to '''Old Ascalon''' and head west to find the encampment.'' :''"I don't trust these Krytans. I want you to take someone with you in case there's trouble. I'm sure '''Alesia''' will be willing to go with you, and she can heal you if need be."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = You can rely on me. | decline = This is too great a burden. I am not worthy. }} :(not in a party) {{ Offer dialog | ask = I thought I told you not to try this on your own. Forming a party is a simple matter. Find someone willing to go with you and simply invite them into your group. '''Alesia''' or any of the others standing by the gate will be more than happy to join you, I'm sure. }} :(while in a party) {{ Offer dialog | ask = Have you delivered that '''message''' yet? I chose you for this task because I thought you were reliable! }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== ;Ambassador Zain :(not in a party) :''"You don't look like a royal messanger, but perhaps that explains why you have come alone. Do you know that every messenger King Adelbern has sent has come with a large escort? If I didn't know better, I'd think he was trying to intimidate me. Now then, what is it you were saying? {{ Offer dialog | decline = Never mind. I'll be back later. | declineicon = {{no}} }} '''Approaching Ambassador Zain's location:''' :'''Prince Rurik:''' ''"Greetings Ambassador Zain. Let me be the first to welcome you to Ascalon."'' :'''Ambassador Zain:''' ''"Ah, Prince Rurik. I thank you for your kind words. I will admit, I was nervous about this meeting. Our initial reception here in Ascalon City has been...less than warm."'' :'''Prince Rurik:''' ''"So I have heard. I apologize for my father. He means well and does what he thinks is best for his country, but sometimes his stubborn memory of the last [[The Guild Wars|Guild War]] gets in his way."'' :'''Ambassador Zain:''' ''"The days of war between our two nations are over. We are here in the name of Kryta to give aid to Ascalon. We ask for nothing in return, and wish only to be of service."'' :'''Prince Rurik:''' ''"We would be foolish to allow our pride to stand in the way of such a generous offer."'' :'''Ambassador Zain:''' ''"Now I see why the people of Ascalon so admire you, Rurik. When it is your turn, you will be a good king. A good king indeed."'' :'''Prince Rurik:''' ''"Thank you, Ambassador. Now I must take my leave. I will talk with the king. Perhaps I can change his mind and gain you access to the city."'' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Ambassador Zain :'''A message with the royal seal? Let's see. Honored Ambassador et cetera...et cetera..."Your request for permission to enter the city and address the people of Ascalon is emphatically denied. This being the fourth such denial, His Majesty bids you reconsider this ill-conceived journey and contemplate a return to Kryta."'' :'' 'King Adelbern and I have learned very different lessons from the wars of past. Isolation is not the answer. Only in peace and mutual friendship shall we find our salvation. I still have hope that in time, he will realize the truth of this.' '' ==Notes== * Forming any group anywhere in the game completes the first objective, despite what the the quest suggests. ** This objective becomes active again if you leave your group at any point in the future. You must face Ambassador Zain in a group if you wish to proceed with the quest. * Prince Rurik will not appear for his dialogue with Ambassador Zain if any member of the party is a non-Prophecies character or has already completed the quest.
